conclusions: The exact crane Save implementation gives digest inputs an i-was-a-digest tag; an output filename alone does not make an archive untagged.
The builder uses an explicit local assembly tag, removes only its manifest data extent, then validates the content-addressed archive before loading.
Current setup retains complete implementation snapshots and bounded failed HTTP response diagnostics.
The denial-path unit control detected an unclosed HTTPError response; explicit closure fixed it without suppressing the warning.
initial_vs_current_implementation: Runtime probe bytes and image inputs are unchanged. Current code additionally records source snapshots and transfer failures, closes HTTPError responses and conforms to the 120-character Python limit. Initial receipts are historical, not current-source attestations.
